# Lulu Aurelian Estate

> Luxury serviced apartments and boutique vacation rentals in Nyeri, Kenya. Offering direct reservations with best-rate guarantee, high-speed 40 Mbps Wi-Fi, fully equipped modern kitchens, scenic Mt. Kenya views, secure keyless self-check-in, and instant M-Pesa Buy Goods payments.

Lulu Aurelian Estate provides premium accommodations in Nyeri Town tailored for business executives, remote professionals, diaspora visitors, tourists, couples, and families seeking refined comfort, absolute privacy, and pristine hygiene with residential warmth.

## Suites & Accommodations

- [Skyview Hideaway](https://www.luluaurelian.co.ke/skyview): Premium 2-bedroom penthouse apartment on the top floor (6th floor) of Skyline Lifestyle Apartments. Features panoramic Mount Kenya views, private balcony with lounge seating, dedicated workspace for remote professionals, fast 40 Mbps Wi-Fi, fully equipped kitchen, and king beds. Standard capacity up to 4 guests (accommodates up to 5 with peak surcharge; 1-bedroom option for up to 3 guests).
- [Cocoa Retreat](https://www.luluaurelian.co.ke/cocoa): Sophisticated 2-bedroom luxury suite on the 4th Floor (Suite 4B) styled in rich earthy cocoa tones. Features plush queen beds, tranquil pine forest neighborhood views, high-speed 40 Mbps Wi-Fi, fully equipped kitchen, quality linens, and free secure parking. Standard capacity up to 4 guests (up to 5 with surcharge; 1-bedroom option for up to 3 guests).
- [Neema Haven](https://www.luluaurelian.co.ke/neema): Serene 2-bedroom sanctuary on the 2nd Floor (Suite 2A) designed for sunset lovers. Sunlit living areas, luxury linens, modern fully equipped kitchen, high-speed 40 Mbps Wi-Fi, quiet acoustics, and spotless finishes. Standard capacity up to 4 guests (up to 5 with surcharge; 1-bedroom option for up to 3 guests).

## Pricing & Rate Structure (Direct Booking)

- **Skyview Hideaway**:
  - Entire Suite: KES 5,500 / night (~USD 42)
  - 1-Bedroom Executive Rate: KES 4,000 / night (valid for 1–3 guests)
- **Cocoa Retreat**:
  - Entire Suite: KES 5,000 / night (~USD 38)
  - 1-Bedroom Rate: KES 4,000 / night (valid for 1–3 guests)
- **Neema Haven**:
  - Entire Suite: KES 5,000 / night (~USD 38)
  - 1-Bedroom Rate: KES 4,000 / night (valid for 1–3 guests)
- **Length-of-Stay Discounts**:
  - 3+ Nights: 5% discount
  - 7+ Nights (Weekly): 10% discount
  - 30+ Nights (Monthly): 20% discount
- **Peak Guest Surcharge**: A modest surcharge of KES 1,500 / night applies when booking an entire suite at maximum capacity (5 adults).
- **Direct Booking Perks**: Best rate guarantee with zero third-party platform fees (save 14–18% compared to Airbnb & Booking.com), instant 60-minute reservation hold, free cancellation, and direct concierge support.

## Amenities & Highlights

- **Kitchen & Dining**: Modern, fully equipped kitchens in each suite featuring cookware, dinnerware, microwave, refrigerator, and cooking appliances for complete self-catering independence.
- **Connectivity & Remote Work**: High-speed 40 Mbps Wi-Fi in every suite, with a dedicated executive workspace in Skyview Hideaway.
- **Self Check-In**: Keyless contactless self-check-in via secure digital lockbox. Passcodes and check-in directions are automatically dispatched upon payment.
- **Scenic Views**: Top-floor wrap-around views of Mount Kenya and surrounding lush Central Kenya highlands.
- **Security & Parking**: 24/7 building security, gated perimeter, and complimentary covered parking on premises.
- **Comfort & Cleanliness**: Premium linens, comfortable orthopedic mattresses, hot showers, and spotless hygiene standards.

## Reservation & Payment Options

- **Direct Booking**: Instant reservation via https://www.luluaurelian.co.ke with instant 60-minute calendar hold upon checkout initiation.
- **Primary Payment Method**:
  - Safaricom M-Pesa Buy Goods / Till Number: **174379** (Automated STK push prompt sent directly to guest phone, with automated instant payment verification).
  - Manual payment via M-Pesa menu to Till Number 174379 with Booking Reference.
- **Alternative Payment Methods**: Direct Bank Transfer (EFT/RTGS), Credit/Debit Card, or Corporate Invoice arranged directly with host concierge via WhatsApp during the booking hold.
- **OTA Channels**: Also bookable on [Airbnb (Skyview)](https://www.airbnb.com/h/pearlapartmentsnyeri), [Airbnb (Cocoa)](https://www.airbnb.com/h/cocoapearlapartment), and [Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/Share-F7S7E5V).
- **Calendar & Availability**: Real-time two-way automated iCal synchronization across Airbnb, Booking.com, and direct website to prevent double-bookings.

## Policies & Details

- **Check-in Time**: From 14:00 (2:00 PM) East Africa Time (EAT). Keyless lockbox self-check-in.
- **Check-out Time**: By 11:00 AM East Africa Time (EAT).
- **Smoking Policy**: Strictly non-smoking inside suites; dedicated outdoor balcony smoking areas available.
- **Quiet Hours**: 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. Parties and unauthorized gatherings strictly prohibited.
- **Children**: Children of all ages welcome.
